crossRefs.note: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children…
Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the…
Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.
Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive…
What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified…
Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and…
Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear…
If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
translations.bsb: Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
translations.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken
translations.asv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!
